# Conventional Commits Instructions

All suggested commit messages must conform to [Conventional Commits v1.0.0](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).

Format: `<type>[optional scope]: <description>`

Valid types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.

Requirements:
- Imperative mood in description
- No trailing period
- Use `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` for breaking changes
- Add body/footer only when clarifying
- Scope should reflect affected area
- Keep description under 72 chars
